_comment: Structured daily opening intervals extracted from research (raw text + sources in opening_hours_research.json). Hours are in 24h decimal (e.g. 12.5 = 12:30). Multiple intervals mean a midday closure gap. Day-of-week variation (e.g. some places closing Tuesdays) is not modeled here since the emission table only covers Morning/Afternoon/Evening within a visiting day, not day-of-week.

P01.note: Open public beach, no gate/entry control.
